question: The census operations of India had been carried out in ________ phases according to census 2011.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **census operations of India** had been carried out in **two phases** according to census 2011.
 
• The first phase is called the **House Listing and Housing Census**, which involves listing all houses and collecting data on housing conditions, household amenities, and assets.
 
• The second phase is the **Population Enumeration**, which involves collecting information about all persons residing in India on the reference date.
 
• The Census of India is conducted every **ten years** by the Office of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner under the Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The first synchronous census in India was held in **1881**.
 
• The Census is a **statutory exercise** conducted under the provisions of the **Census Act, 1948**.
 
• The data collected through the census is used for **policy-making, planning, and administration** by the government.
 
• The Census also provides valuable information for **demographic research** and analysis.
 
• India's Census is one of the most comprehensive and detailed data collection exercises in the world, covering the entire population of the country.
